description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per log - the payment buys one signed lifecycle analysis of the challenge-issuance log you submit: issued / used / expired-unused / pending counts, the expiry-window distribution, and the per-rail split where the log carries a rail field, computed mechanically under the published rules. Counts only - no buyer identity appears anywhere in the report; a count the log cannot support is reported NOT-COMPUTABLE, never estimated.

as_of.description: The evaluation timestamp (ISO 8601) the counts are computed as of.

log.description: The challenge-issuance log to analyse: entries with challenge_id, issued_at, expires_at, optional used_at and rail, in the published log contract form. Processed in memory only, never stored.

name: lifecycle_analyse
